features.text: Open patella design reduces pressure on the kneecap while maintaining stability
Premium neoprene material provides therapeutic warmth for joint pain relief
Optional patella padding available for enhanced protection and comfort
Consistent compression helps reduce swelling and supports muscle recovery
Streamlined design fits comfortably under clothing for all-day wear

measurement: For optimal compression and support, measure the circumference of your knee at the center of the patella. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for detailed sizing guidance and expert fitting assistance.
